source.title: Associative Convolutional Layers
source.authors: H. Omidvar; Vahideh Akhlaghi; M. Franceschetti; Rajesh K. Gupta

record.file_problem: None; the full paper text is present.
record.tranche_reason: Reports training-error curves for CIFAR-10 CNNs trained from scratch, bearing on whether training reaches low training error, but does not test the claim’s broader settings such as random labels or CIFAR-100.
record.gate_note: The paper reports test-error numbers in Tables 1 and 2, but those do not measure the claimed training-error outcome. Training-error curves are shown in figures without textual descriptions or extractable numeric values, so the rows retain figure-only values and cannot determine the outcome.
record.test_reason: The study reports its own training-classification-error curves on CIFAR-10 for standard CNNs and a new compressed parameterization trained from scratch. These bear on V1, although the supplied text preserves no readable curve values from which to establish near-zero error.
record.authors_conclusion: The record's paraphrase is broadly accurate: the authors conclude that CSG reduces convolutional parameter counts while generally preserving predictive accuracy and approximately preserving processing time, with greater accuracy losses under extreme compression. They state that convergence occurred in all experiments, but do not state that every model reached zero or near-zero training classification error.
record.recipe_differences: Trains CNNs with an auxiliary convolutional slice generator and code vectors, changing the parameterization; experiments use CIFAR-10 and ImageNet classification.
record.method_sensitivity: Parameter compression and CSG configuration vary across models; the paper notes higher accuracy loss in extreme compression cases.

fits_no_version.finding: Theorem 2 asserts polynomial-time SGD convergence to an epsilon-error squared-loss solution for a sufficiently overparameterized, single-convolution-layer CSG network on non-degenerate data.
fits_no_version.proposed_claim: Sufficiently overparameterized single-layer CSG networks admit an SGD convergence guarantee under the theorem's assumptions.

record.problems: Training-error outcomes relevant to V1 appear in plots without numeric reporting or textual descriptions. The experimental datasets do not include CIFAR-100 or corrupted/random labels.
record.rows_left_out: No rows omitted. Test-error table results were excluded because they do not measure the training-error behavior named in V1.

untested.parts: CIFAR-100, corrupted or random labels, optimizer comparisons, early stopping, and systematic comparisons of model size or regularization are not tested. The empirical optimizer is not specified in the supplied text.
Two-layer ReLU teacher-student local minima and extra student neurons.
Depth degradation and controlled comparisons of plain networks, identity shortcuts, or alternative initialization.
Initialization comparisons, signal or gradient propagation, training speed, and maximum trainable depth.
Learning rates relative to initial stability thresholds, curvature changes, catapult recovery, and edge-of-stability dynamics.
Training speed and learning-rate tolerance with versus without batch normalization or Fixup.

missing.what: Three additional CIFAR-10 training-error curves: DenseNet-BC-40-48 with CSG pretrained on itself, with CSG pretrained on DenseNet-BC-40-36, and with compressed 1x1 kernels. The record incorrectly says no rows were omitted. Curve values remain unreadable in the supplied text; pretrained cases require an explicit fixed-CSG condition.
Training-error curve for DenseNet-BC-40-36 with fixed CSG pretrained on DenseNet-BC-40-48. It is absent from R5–R6 and is not declared omitted. Its endpoint is unreadable in the supplied text.
missing.locator: Appendix B, Figure 5, bottom panel; Section 4.3

missing.what: Training-error curves for ResNet-56-CSG-[12,12,3,3]-72 and ResNet-56 with fixed CSG pretrained on ResNet-20. Neither is recorded or declared omitted. Panel titles identify ResNet models despite the erroneous DenseNet figure caption; endpoints are unreadable.

record.verdict_notes: No verdict label is justified by the readable evidence: convergence alone does not establish near-zero training classification error. Tables 1–2 report held-out errors, not training errors. ImageNet training curves in Figure 3 fall outside V1's named datasets. The study is not an original source for any version.

versions.untested_parts: CIFAR-100, corrupted or random labels, Adam, smaller models, early stopping, and regularized recipes are not tested. The plotted training-error values are not numerically reported.
